Close Photo Previous Photo Next Photo Photo link Table of ContentsWELCOME TO KSUVirtual ViewSCHEDULE A TOURSTUDENT LIFEAthletics Link to story section - WELCOME TO KSU WELCOME TO KSU While Kennesaw State University began as a small-town college in 1963, the KSU you visit today is the third-largest university in Georgia with more than 50,000 students from 106 different countries.As a Carnegie-designated R2 research university with more than 190 undergraduate, graduate and doctoral degree programs, you will take courses taught by experienced and dedicated faculty focused on student-centered success. You can take advantage of hands-on and experiential learning resources that prepare you to be a future-ready graduate.The living and learning opportunities on campus combine your extracurricular activities, academic classes and friends to encourage you to become a member of Owl Nation. Welcome and come explore KSU! With over 300 student organizations on campus, you will get to know interesting people, become a part of the community, and create a niche. You can get involved on campus- take your pick: Kennesaw Activities Board, Student Government Association, Greek organizations, recreational clubs, leadership organizations and many more. At KSU, you can cheer on our 18 NCAA Division I athletic teams as they compete across the country against the nation's top student-athletes. Boasting 26 national and conference championships, the Owls are a force to be reckoned with. Come to the Convocation Center to watch men's and women's basketball, women's volleyball, or our cheerleading and dance teams. All home athletic events are free for KSU students.
